messages:
Priya: Heads-up — NimbleIndustries showing a ~67% drop in prod token usage over the last 7d. Renewal in ~6w. Their champion went on sabbatical and procurement is running a short PoC with BeamAI. Can we triage risk and outline a rescue plan? cc @Jordan
Jordan: On it. Thanks for flagging. I have a meeting with procurement next Wed. Do we have concrete latency / cost deltas to show ASAP?
Sam: Quick signal from infra: 95p latency spiked after their stress run on 2026-03-12. We saw a fallback to the quantized variant for a subset of requests which added ~120ms/token. Short log snippet: ```2026-03-12T14:03:22Z route=nlp-prod status=fallback model=redwood-v2q latency=260ms/tok```
Priya: Oof. They did a 500-conc stress test. If that's the quantization fallback, cost looked lower but latency caused their infra team to tighten concurrency. Can we propose config changes to stabilize latency immediately?
Sam: Yes — immediate suggestions: set max_batch_size=8 for the high-priority route, enable prefix cache (ttl=600s) for repeated prompts, and pin the route to redwood-v1 for low-latency endpoints. I'll produce a small perf delta doc.
Jordan: That would help. Procurement has flagged price per 1M tokens as the key metric vs BeamAI. Can we pull a 30d usage + cost comparison to show total cost of ownership?
Priya: I'll pull charts. @OpsBot — please attach the last 30d token usage + cost export for nimble_industries-prod (csv or dashboard link).
OpsBot: Attached export: https://dash.redwood.internal/exports/nimble_industries-prod-30d.csv (access: redacted). Summary: tokens -40% MoM, infra-cost -22% MoM, average latency +18% (95p).
Jordan: Great. I'll draft a 2-slide ROI (cost vs latency tradeoff + proposed config). Priya — can we also ask the customer to pause the PoC run that triggers the fallback until we test config? Might be easiest ask.
Priya: I'll reach out. Also Maya (their contact) asked for an exec-friendly one-pager explaining why latency changed and what we'll do. Sam — could you produce that + a runnable perf harness for them to run with our suggested settings?
Sam: Yep. I'll create a 1-pager + a small bench script (will share gist). Plan: measure before/after with max_batch_size and prefix cache enabled; expect 95p latency down ~15-25% on typical traffic.
Jordan: I'm scheduling a joint QBR with Eng + CS to walk procurement through fix and roadmap (proposed Thu 10am next week). Priya — can you confirm availability?
Priya: Confirmed. Next steps summary: 1) Sam: config + 1-pager + bench by Tue EOD; 2) Jordan: ROI slides by Wed; 3) Priya: schedule QBR and pull any additional contract levers. If usage drops further before QBR, escalate to Enterprise Success. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Added a risk flag in CRM (status=at-risk) and noted BeamAI PoC.
Priya: Thanks team. I'll message Maya with the ask to pause the heavy PoC runs and offer the config trial. If procurement pushes on cost only, we'll use the ROI slide + perf numbers to defend retention. Ping here with any updates.
